lead: No sector-wide cluster today, but the strongest signal is the actual IDBI privatization approval (Cabinet-approved Fairfax sale, +329cr delivery) alongside a genuine blowout quarter from Transformers & Rectifiers (PAT +338% YoY, order book Rs7,237cr). 6 ACT names, all filing-explained; 3 WATCH names (Rain, West Coast Paper, Indo SMC) are delivery-backed with no discoverable trigger after checking filings, Stockscans catalysts and concalls - flagged honestly as unexplained rather than guessed at.
caveats: Filing Extract Store had zero cache hits for today's universe (contentFromExtractCache: 0/75) - every content classification was a live fetch; the preprocessing queue needs to run before this scan, not after.

EPS theses below were built from each company's own trigger filing read this run, not a full rerating-catalysts 4-concall/2-PPT document sweep - treat them as lightweight briefs, not the full J-curve build.

Full widget+PDF J-curve reports for the top-3 (TARIL/IDBI/SSRETAIL) were not generated this run - that requires multi-agent Workflow orchestration outside this session's current scope. Flagging as a deferral, not a silent drop.

NSE:TARIL.headline: PAT +338% YoY; order book Rs7,237cr (+32%), inquiry pipeline Rs21,000cr
thesisChain: so the order book itself grew 32% YoY to Rs7,237cr with 18-24mo visibility

why.text: Q2FY27 PAT up 338% YoY (Rs75cr) on EBITDA +205% (Rs114cr) and revenue +66% (Rs709cr); order inflow +97% YoY to Rs1,169cr lifted the unexecuted order book 32% YoY to Rs7,237cr.

epsImpact.magnitude: PAT +338% YoY this quarter; multi-year order book visibility

epsThesis.jCurveReason: Q2FY27 PAT +338% YoY on EBITDA margin expansion (8.7%->16.1%... actually 16.1% margin, up from 8.7%) and record order inflow; the Rs7,237cr order book (+32% YoY, 18-24mo executable) plus Rs21,000cr inquiry pipeline give multi-year revenue visibility.
epsThesis.thesis: A genuine J-curve name if execution holds: margin expansion plus a record, growing order book extend visible EPS growth well beyond this quarter, not just a one-off beat.

catalysts.name: Order book Rs7,237cr (+32% YoY); order inflow +97% YoY to Rs1,169cr
EBITDA margin expansion to 16.1% from 8.7% YoY on operating leverage

catalystRisks: YoY comps get tougher from here (base effect)
execution risk scaling into a Rs7,237cr backlog
epsThesis.creator: rerating-catalysts
epsThesis.cacheReason: built from today's trigger filing only (gainers-signal run) - not a full document sweep

NSE:IDBI.headline: Cabinet approves Fairfax as strategic buyer for 60.72% IDBI stake
thesisChain: CCEA approves sale of GoI (30.48%) + LIC (30.24%) stake
to Fairfax Financial Holdings (via 10955230 Canada Inc.)
so a 4-year disinvestment overhang is finally resolved

why.text: Ministry of Finance press release confirms CCEA approved Fairfax Financial Holdings as Strategic Buyer for 60.72% of IDBI Bank.
sources: PIB/Ministry of Finance release via BSE/NSE filing 14-Oct-2026

epsImpact.magnitude: re-rating on resolved ownership overhang, not an EPS move

epsThesis.jCurveReason: Not an operating J-curve but a binary corporate-action re-rating: CCEA formally approved selling 60.72% of IDBI Bank to Fairfax Financial Holdings, ending four years of disinvestment overhang.
epsThesis.thesis: Re-rating driven by resolution of ownership-structure uncertainty and the prospect of private-style governance under Fairfax, not by an EPS growth curve.

catalysts.name: CCEA approves Fairfax Financial Holdings as strategic buyer for 60.72% stake
catalysts.conviction: HIGH CONVICTION - official PIB/Ministry of Finance release 14-Oct-2026
catalysts.timeline: deal completion timeline not yet disclosed

catalystRisks: RBI and other regulatory approvals for the buyer still pending
post-deal strategic direction and integration uncertain

NSE:SSRETAIL.headline: Record Q1FY27: revenue +59% YoY, SSS +34%, 33 new stores
thesisChain: same-store sales +34%, 33 net new stores (536 total)
reinforced today by Chairman's media interview

why.text: Media release "SS Retail Posts Record Q1 FY27" (revenue +59% YoY, SSS +34%) dated 13-Oct, reinforced by a Chairman media interview on 14-Oct. Note: Q1FY27 = Apr-Jun26, an unusually long reporting lag.

epsThesis.jCurveReason: Record Q1FY27 growth (revenue +59% YoY, SSS +34%, 33 new stores) is genuine, but the unusual results lag (Q1FY27 = Apr-Jun26, disclosed only in mid-Oct) and thin 5.8% EBITDA margin temper conviction.
epsThesis.thesis: Aggressive, profitable store rollout with strong same-store growth, but data freshness and margin thinness are real caveats on the pace of EPS accretion.

catalysts.name: Revenue +59% YoY, EBITDA +51%, PAT +61%, SSS +34%, 33 net new stores
catalysts.conviction: MODERATE - genuine growth, but reported with an unusual lag

catalystRisks: unusual results-reporting lag raises a data-freshness question
EBITDA margin only 5.8%, thin for a growth narrative
recently consolidated Olineo/Nexora added 79bps of EBITDA-level cost

NSE:ELECON.headline: Q2FY27 steady growth + interim dividend; Gear order book +37% YoY
thesisChain: Gear division order book +37% YoY to Rs1,056cr
but standalone EPS fell YoY (Rs3.33 vs Rs3.52) - mixed, not a blowout

why.text: Q2FY27 consolidated revenue +8.5% YoY, EBITDA +11.1% (margin 23.9%); Gear order book +37% YoY to Rs1,056cr; interim dividend Re0.50/share declared. Standalone EPS down YoY.

epsImpact.magnitude: Gear order book +37% YoY vs standalone EPS -5% YoY

epsThesis.jCurveReason: Consolidated growth is real but modest (revenue +8.5%, EBITDA +11.1% YoY); the Gear division's order book (+37% YoY to Rs1,056cr) is the strongest single data point, while standalone EPS actually declined YoY - this reads as steady compounding, not an inflection.
epsThesis.thesis: A quality compounder with a growing order book in its core Gear segment, but this quarter is not itself an EPS inflection - standalone EPS fell YoY and MHE division margins compressed.

catalysts.name: Gear division order book +37% YoY to Rs1,056cr; EBIT +27.2% YoY
MHE division order book +27.3% YoY to Rs579cr

catalystRisks: standalone EPS down YoY (Rs3.33 vs Rs3.52)
MHE margin compression from unfavorable product mix and delayed clearances

still deploying IPO capex, 65% capacity utilisation

epsImpact.magnitude: revenue +90% YoY off a small base

NSE:MVELECTRO.headline: Kotak MF crosses 5% stake - modest buy, doesn't fully explain +17% move
thesisChain: but that's a thin explanation for a Rs99cr delivery day

why.text: A SAST filing shows Kotak Mahindra MF crossing 5% via a modest 100,000-share purchase - real but a thin explanation for a +17.2% day on Rs99cr delivery.

epsThesis.jCurveReason: The only disclosed catalyst is a modest SAST threshold-crossing (Kotak MF, 4.67%->5.04% via a 100,000-share open-market buy) - a positive signal of institutional interest but not an operating or EPS catalyst, and it under-explains the day's move.
epsThesis.thesis: No operating catalyst identified this run; the thesis rests entirely on one mutual fund's incremental accumulation, which is thin support for a J-curve call.

catalysts.conviction: LOW CONVICTION - threshold-crossing disclosure, not an operating catalyst

catalystRisks: no operating/EPS catalyst found to accompany the price move
filing under-explains the magnitude of the day's move (+17% on Rs99cr delivery)
